scope.interactionChannel: isolated product overlay and real macOS keyboard input via cliclick

observations.name: physical model query
observations.detail: Real OS typing enters gpt in the focused Native model search and filters the visible list to matching GPT models.

observations.name: physical Escape dismissal
observations.detail: A real Escape key leaves the focused Model Picker open; the post-key frame is byte-identical to the query frame.
